name: pnp-copilot-pro-dev-mcs-finance-statement-agent
title: Finance Statement Agent
shortDescription: A Copilot Studio agent that extracts financial statements from uploaded PDFs and generates an Excel workbook.
longDescription: Conversational AI for credit financial statement extraction. An analyst uploads a PDF report in Microsoft Teams, and a Copilot Studio agent orchestrates an Azure-hosted pipeline to extract income statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and ratios into a downloadable Excel workbook.
